name: Moving Average Trade System
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on moving average signals, entering trades when price crosses or aligns with a moving average. It systematically opens buy or sell positions depending on the relationship between price and the configured moving average indicator. The system includes basic parameter configuration for MA period, method, and applied price.
summary_zh: 该EA基于移动平均线信号实现趋势跟踪策略，当价格穿越或对齐移动平均线时入场交易。根据价格与配置的移动平均线指标之间的关系，系统性地开立买入或卖出仓位。系统包含MA周期、方法和应用价格的基本参数配置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于移动平均线的趋势跟踪，通过判断价格与移动平均线的相对位置关系来确定市场方向。入场条件为价格从下方突破移动平均线时做多，价格从上方跌破移动平均线时做空，属于典型的均线交叉/突破策略。出场条件依赖于均线的反向信号触发，可能缺乏独立的止损和止盈机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，没有明显的风险控制模块如最大回撤限制或仓位比例控制，整体策略逻辑清晰但风险保护不足。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on moving averages, determining market direction by evaluating the relative position of price to the moving average line. Entry conditions are triggered when price breaks above the moving average for buy signals and breaks below for sell signals, representing a classic MA crossover/breakout approach. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals from the moving average, which may lack independent stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, with no visible risk control modules such as maximum drawdown limits or position ratio controls, making the overall strategy logic clear but risk protection insufficient.

parameters.name: MA_Applied_Price
parameters.description: 移动平均线应用价格类型

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
趋势跟踪在明确趋势市场中表现良好，能捕捉大波段行情
参数可配置，用户可根据不同品种和周期调整均线参数
代码结构相对简洁，便于二次开发和功能扩展
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Trend following performs well in clear trending markets, capturing large swing moves
Configurable parameters allow users to adjust MA settings for different instruments and timeframes
Relatively clean code structure facilitates secondary development and feature extension
cons: 缺乏独立止损止盈机制，出场完全依赖反向信号，可能导致大幅回撤
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户资金比例，存在过度交易风险
在震荡市中均线策略容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
未包含点差过滤、新K线检查等防重复入场机制
没有多时间周期确认，单一均线信号可靠性有限
cons_en: Lacks independent stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms, exits rely entirely on reverse signals which may lead to significant drawdowns
Fixed lot position sizing does not consider account equity ratio, posing overtrading risk
MA strategies tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Missing spread filter, new bar check, and other anti-duplicate entry mechanisms
No multi-timeframe confirmation, single MA signal reliability is limited
improvements: 增加独立的止损止盈参数和多条件出场机制，降低单笔交易风险
引入多时间周期确认和附加指标过滤（如RSI、ATR），减少虚假信号
实现基于账户资金比例的动态仓位管理和最大回撤保护
improvements_en: Add independent stop-loss/take-profit parameters and multi-condition exit mechanisms to reduce per-trade risk
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation and additional indicator filters (e.g., RSI, ATR) to reduce false signals
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity ratio and maximum drawdown protection

risk_points: 出场依赖反向均线信号，缺乏硬止损保护，极端行情下可能造成巨大亏损
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能因单笔过大而快速爆仓
未检测新K线周期，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Exits depend on reverse MA signals without hard stop-loss protection, potentially causing massive losses in extreme market conditions
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size, small accounts may blow up quickly from oversized single positions
No new bar detection may cause duplicate position opening on the same candle
